role: Technical outcome-blind environmental export only. No biological flower-colour values may be read, copied, joined, summarized or inferred.

environment_source.standardization: Use the exact global terrestrial physical mean and ddof0 SD already recorded in each completed block result source_audit. Do not recompute or refit standardization from flower observations.

execution.download_rule: Download each exact CHELSA file separately from the frozen provider URL, verify byte SHA256 before sampling, sample all 50,000 fixed coordinates, then delete that raster before downloading the next.

output.columns: geometry columns plus twelve globally standardized environmental z-values
output.primary_future_frame: 369 fixed species and existing global_classifiable mask only; this export itself does not select or remove species
required_audit: block joint completeness for all 50,000 rows and for retained classifiable rows

claim_ceiling: Provides a checksum-verified real environmental coordinate representation for later synthetic method qualification. It is not a flower-colour result, does not test heat/dryness effects, and cannot alter any existing empirical decision.
